title: Welcome
summary: The first screen when the phone has no Bipe account. It says what Bipe is and offers one filled button that starts sign-up, plus a row for people who already have an account. The button depends on the invite state (registries/onboarding.json start).

code.description: The invite code, normalised (BipeInviteLink.normalizedCode on iOS). Never shown in full.

inviterHandle.description: The inviter's handle without @, from GET /v1/invites/{code}. Absent when the invite has none or is not valid.

variant.description: loading: GET /v1/signup/config runs (at most 3 s, then inviteOnly). invited, inviteOnly, open: the start variant of registries/onboarding.json that matches invitePending and inviteRequired.

invite.description: The invite that came with a link, the install referrer (Android) or a paste. Its presence is invitePending.

inviteRequired.description: invite_required from GET /v1/signup/config. true when the app cannot read it.

termsVersion.description: terms_version from GET /v1/signup/config. signup-name sends it after the checkbox.

clipboardHasText.description: true when the system clipboard holds text. Shows the paste row. The app reads the text only after a tap on that row.

pasteResult.description: notAnInvite: the pasted text holds no Bipe invite. Shows bipe_onboarding_paste_invite_none.

appear.effect: Reads GET /v1/signup/config and, when an invite is pending, GET /v1/invites/{code}. On Android it also reads the Play install referrer once (bipeinstallreferrer). Sets variant.

url.description: A bipe.chat/convite/<code> link the app was opened with.

openInviteLink.effect: Takes the code from the link, previews it and sets variant to invited. A link that is not an invite does nothing.

pasteInvite.effect: Reads the clipboard once, takes the invite code from the text (registries/invite-codes.json rules) and previews it. With no code, sets pasteResult to notAnInvite.

primary.effect: Follows the primary button of the variant: invited and open go to signup-name with the invite (if any); inviteOnly goes to signup-invite-code. A pending invite is checked again with GET /v1/invites/{code} first (bipe-chat/bipe#460): valid false goes to signup-invite-code with bipe_invite_no_longer_valid under the field; no network keeps the invite and goes on, as signup-create checks it again.

haveAccount.effect: Opens the way back into an existing account (recovery-start, bipe-chat/bipe#555).

notes: Each pair of invitePending and inviteRequired matches exactly one start variant in registries/onboarding.json. The generated onboarding code (gen.mjs) gives the title and buttons; the screen never hard-codes them.
The points list keeps the order of linguagem.md section 3: scam check, Brazil, no ads.
bipe_onboarding_invited_by takes the inviter's handle with @ in front. An invite without a handle, or not valid, shows the open or inviteOnly variant and keeps the code for signup-invite-code.
The clipboard is read only after a tap on the paste row, never on launch (iOS shows a paste notice).

The screen talks only to bipe-api (no auth). The Matrix client does not exist yet. Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.signupConfig and invitePreview, BipeInviteLink (iOS); BipeApiClient, BipeStartScreenInfo (Android).
account-start shows this screen when its phase is noAccount.
